body: Operator report: downstream counts dropped by two thirds overnight with no error anywhere. The upstream API now paginates its list responses — fetch_page(page) returns {'items': [...], 'next_page': <int or None>} — but app/apiclient.py fetch_all(fetch_page) still reads only the first page and ignores next_page, silently truncating the list. Fix fetch_all() so it follows next_page until it is None and returns every page's items concatenated in page order. Acceptance: a three-page upstream (pages returning next_page 2, then 3, then None) yields all items in order; a single-page upstream and an empty first page behave exactly as today; existing tests still pass.
title: API client silently drops every page after the first
